pages.text: ‘ST-242 1st printing -—— Important Note to Operators If the operation, maintenance and service manual was not included in this game when you unpacked it, contact your distributor to get a free copy. (All Atari manuals for coin-operated games also include complete illustrated parts lists.) To enter the self-test mode, turn on the self-test switch. The self-test switch is located on the utility panel of ATARI-built games. On converted games not originally manufactured by ATARI, the self-test switch is the locking spring-loaded pushbutton switch located on the game coin door. This 2-Player Start switch is labeled AUTO-UP, MANUAL DOWN. To exit the Press to start or stop game self-test mode, press the switch down into its locked posi- Sounds.
